articles.title: Japan's Tashima to stand against Infantino for Fifa presidency
articles.summary: Japan's Kozo Tashima has announced his candidacy for Fifa's upcoming presidential election.

Infantino faces fight for FIFA presidency as first challenger emerges
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino is facing his first serious challenger for the FIFA presidency after Japanese football chief Kohzo Tashima announced his intention to stand in March's election.
